answer: You can gently mention it right away, as birthdays are usually easy to remember: “Hey, did you forget my birthday? I mean, people forget their own birthday every year, so you probably didn’t mean to.” That frame makes your friend feel less guilty, so they often remember faster and are less likely to mention other things they might have missed.
